suggestions.proposedValue: For the MVP, use Preparer e-file submissions (curated) to enable weekly preparer risk scoring; document the current scoring baseline, first user group, and how the change contributes to the selected tax-gap lever.
suggestions.rationale: The draft names a weekly workflow and dataset but not the baseline, first users, or causal measure reviewers need to assess the selected mission outcome.

citations.quote: Enable weekly preparer risk scoring and retire three contractor-run extracts.

suggestions.proposedValue: Explain the baseline and calculation supporting the submitted $750,000 annual benefit and 1,200 hours saved, separating tax-gap impact from contractor-extract savings to avoid double counting.
